name: totalsegmentator-ct
label: TotalSegmentator (upstream image + seg-wrapup)
description: Upstream TotalSegmentator on a DICOM scan; seg-wrapup adds the volumetrics report, label files and DICOM SEG
command-line: TotalSegmentator -i /input -o /output/segmentation.nii.gz --ml --statistics --task #TASK# && python -c "import json,sys; from totalsegmentator.map_to_binary import class_map; json.dump({str(k): v for k, v in class_map[sys.argv[1]].items()}, open('/output/labels.json', 'w'))" #TASK# && cp -r /input /output/.source_dicom

outputs.name: segmentation
outputs.description: Label map, statistics.json, labels.json and the copied source series for the wrapup

xnat.name: totalsegmentator-ct-scan
xnat.label: TotalSegmentator on scan (DICOM)
xnat.description: Run TotalSegmentator on a scan's DICOM resource; output lands on the scan as TOTALSEG

derived-inputs.name: scan-dicom
derived-inputs.description: The DICOM resource on the scan
